description: Original pancreas scIB benchmark dataset (Luecken et al. 2022 Nature Methods). 16382 cells; 14 cell types; 6 sequencing technologies. This is the reference benchmark from Kedzierska et al. 2024. Note: the X_geneformer X_scgpt_human and X_scvi_dropin embeddings are SYNTHETIC embeddings engineered by the checkatlas pipeline for scFM-QC testing not real scFM model outputs. Only X_pca is computed from real data.
